subject: froghopper
title: This Tiny Bug Jumps Up to 400 Times Gravity's Pull

scenes.text: This bug is a quarter inch long, but it can out-jump a flea.
It's the froghopper, also called the spittlebug.
Filmed at 2,000 frames a second, it leaps about 70 centimeters, more than two feet.
That's roughly 110 times its own body length. A human would clear a skyscraper.
For a split second it pulls about 400 times the force of gravity. A fighter pilot handles around 10.
Scientists at Cambridge filmed it. So the tiniest jumper on the lawn beats everything else with six legs.
